title: Bicycle parking secure, undercover and reached by a continuous path of travel from the vehicle or cycle entry
text: Secure, undercover bicycle parking is provided ... and accessed via a continuous path of travel from the vehicle or cycle entry point.
notes: parking.bicycle_secure_undercover_path (proposed): the resident bicycle parking is secure and undercover and reached by a continuous path of travel. verify: whether 'secure, undercover' applies to visitor spaces too (DG 3.9.8 separates them).

verified.note: p46 A3.9.1 applies 'secure, undercover' to bicycle parking 'in accordance with Table 3.9', which includes visitor spaces; DG 3.9.8 (p47) limits secure undercover parking to residents.
